title: A Structurally Flat Triangular Form for Three-Input Systems
summary: We present a broadly applicable structurally flat triangular form for x-flat control-affine systems with three inputs. Building on recent results for the derivative structure of flat outputs, we define the triangular form together with regularity conditions that guarantee structural flatness, and derive necessary and sufficient conditions for a system with a given x-flat output to be static feedback equivalent to this form.
